title: Ghiyasuddin Balban
note: Banglapedia biography by ABM Shamsuddin Ahmed, used for the Delhi Sultan's eastern campaign and appointment of Bughra Khan. This is a modern reference synthesis; dates and narrative details differ in places from Jadunath Sarkar's later reconstruction.
whyItMatters: It summarizes Balban's 1280 eastern campaign and his appointment of Bughra Khan after suppressing Tughral, documenting a modern reference account of the return of Delhi's control.
